title: Amazon Aurora Serverless with Secrets Manager
description: Create an Aurora Serverless cluster with Secrets Manager.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template for deploying an Aurora Serverless database cluster, a secret in Secrets Manager, and required VPC with subnets.

testing.headline: Testing
text: See testing in the README.md file in the repo
